name: discord-drop
description: Discord cards through a webhook, only when you're away: results with plots, finished tasks, failed jobs, questions waiting for you. Silent while you work with Claude.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (min)
awayMinutes.description: Minutes without a message from you to this session before Claude's cards reach Discord. Until then nothing is sent unless you ask.

needsYouMinutes.title: Waiting on you (min)
needsYouMinutes.description: A permission prompt or a question left unanswered this long is sent to Discord.

safetyNet.title: Safety net
safetyNet.description: When a long stretch of work ends while you're away and Claude sent nothing, send a short 'done' card.

sessionEndMinutes.title: Hand-off before the allocation ends (min)
sessionEndMinutes.description: Inside a Slurm job, this long before it ends Claude sends where it left off (only when you're away).

purgeWarnDays.title: Scratch purge warning (days)
purgeWarnDays.description: Days before the monthly /scratch purge (first Tuesday) to send your scratch usage. 0 turns it off.

language.title: Card language
language.description: Language of the cards the mod writes itself: es or en.
